data.long_meaning: The name Arshak is derived from the Armenian word 'arshakan', which means 'mountain king'. This name is rich in symbolism, representing power, strength, and the majesty of nature. The name Arshak carries the meaning “Mountain king” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Armenian. Parents who choose Arshak usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
